summary: MacKenzie Realty Capital, a Maryland REIT listed on Nasdaq under MKZR, filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, reporting two housekeeping items. Under Item 7.01, letters to Series A, B and C preferred holders will be mailed on or about October 15, 2026. Under Item 8.01, the company notified preferred holders of a temporary suspension of its Dividend Reinvestment Program and the board approved regular dividends for the quarter ending December 31, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor or closing terms are stated. Not a special situation; monitor DRIP reinstatement and preferred dividend coverage.
